newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's ICA denies reports of tax debt.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's ICA denies reports of tax debt.

text.p: Mexico's Empresas ICA Sociedad Controladora on Monday denied reports that it owed 27.492 billion pesos in back taxes.
The construction company said reports that it owed that amount were published on July 31 in "several media."

"The figure is totally erroneous. The amount corresponds exactly to the value of consolidated assets...in the earnings report for the year to the second quarter that was posted with the Mexican stock market," the company said in a statement.
The statement did not say whether ICA owed back taxes of any amount.
